;Armed conflict and attack
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**[[Boko Haram]] militants open fire on civilians, killing 15 and wounding five others in a fishing village in [[Chad]]. 13 others were missing after the attack. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/chad-dozen-killed-boko-haram-attack-191218140312791.html (Al Jazeera)]
*Gunmen kill two [[Law enforcement in Pakistan|police officers]] escorting a [[polio]] [[vaccination]] team in [[Lower Dir District]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://nationalpost.com/pmn/health-pmn/gunmen-in-pakistan-kill-two-police-escorting-polio-vaccinators (National Post)]

;Arts and culture
*[[Ilham Tohti]], an [[Uyghur people|Uyghur]] [[economist]] serving a [[life sentence]] for his criticisms of [[China]]’s policies in [[Xinjiang]], is awarded this year’s [[Sakharov Prize]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/jailed-uighur-economist-ilham-tohti-receive-sakharov-prize-191216064925850.html (Al Jazeera)]

;International relations
*Pakistan pulls out of an international summit of [[Muslim world|Muslim nations]] in [[Kuala Lumpur]], [[Malaysia]], scheduled to start this Thursday. [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Pakistan)|Foreign Minister]] [[Shah Mahmood Qureshi]] said it was done after [[Saudi Arabia]] and the [[United Arab Emirates]] expressed concern that the summit was to establish a rival bloc to the [[Organisation of Islamic Cooperation]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/pakistan-pulls-malaysia-summit-muslim-nations-191218082917256.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Law and crime
*The [[Cabinet of Germany]] proposes to ban [[conversion therapy]] for both [[transgender]] and [[gay]] people. The proposal was expanded to include people between the ages of 16 and 18. [https://www.dw.com/en/germanys-cabinet-approves-ban-on-gay-transgender-conversion-therapy/a-51717750 (Deutsche Welle)]
*[[First impeachment of Donald Trump|Impeachment of Donald Trump]]
**The [[United States House of Representatives]] votes largely along party lines to [[Impeachment in the United States|impeach]] [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]] for [[abuse of power]] and [[obstruction of Congress]]. Trump becomes the third American president to be impeached by the House, after [[Impeachment of Andrew Johnson|Andrew Johnson]] and [[Impeachment of Bill Clinton|Bill Clinton]]. His impeachment proceedings continue on to the [[United States Senate|Senate]], which will give them a final verdict and decide whether or not he should be removed from office. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/12/18/us/politics/impeachment-vote.html?action=click&module=Spotlight&pgtype=Homepage (''The New York Times'')]

;Science and technology
*[[Cosmic Vision]]
**[[Arianespace]] successfully launches the [[European Space Agency]]'s [[CHEOPS]] [[space telescope]] from [[Guiana Space Centre]]. The European observatory will search for new [[exoplanet]]s and will be able to study an exoplanet's composition and internal structure. The launch also included [[OPS-SAT]], an ESA [[CubeSat]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-50804258 (BBC News)]

**Despite the boycott attempt by [[Democratic Tsunami]], [[El Clásico]] is played in [[Camp Nou]], [[Barcelona]], with important security measures. [https://ruptly.tv/en/events/201912182042-LIVE2242 (Ruptly)]
**The first clashes between [[Mossos d'Esquadra]], [[Boixos Nois]] and protestors occur outside the stadium, leaving 9 arrested and 70 injured.
